name: Emmette Meine
source:
Two, four, six, eight, who do we appreciate? It's Emmette, of course leading her team towards the path to greatness! 

Fueled by fifteen shots of espresso and a box of Coca Crumble donuts, SHE. IS. UNSTOPPABLE!!
